request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Mithril Protocol continuous development through Intersect-administered treasury management contracts.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,810,423 ada, consisting of 3,699,440 ada for Mithril Protocol continuous development and 110,983 ada for an Intersect budget administration fee.
Mithril is presented as addressing slow full-node synchronization and centralized-trust light client reliance by using stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state trustlessly.
The proposer claims Mithril enables rapid state verification for nodes and applications without relying on the entire chain.
The proposal states that faster sync times would reduce onboarding friction and unlock tooling for exchanges, wallets, and monitoring.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and references voting, documentation, audited results, and audit report sources.

The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission time, individually or in aggregate breach the 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, and links to the relevant governance action.
The proposal states audit, oversight, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
The document states Teragone has not previously received direct Cardano treasury or community governance funding but has worked on Mithril for several years through IOG-funded collaboration.

The proposal states funds will be managed through a 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract with specified addresses, permission thresholds, non-staking behavior, auto-abstain DRep delegation, and a public dashboard.
The proposal references the Sundae Labs treasury-contracts repository and two smart-contract audit reports for the budget management framework.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for Mithril Protocol continuous development and Intersect administration, presenting Mithril as trustless Cardano state-certification infrastructure, citing Intersect budget-process support and NCL compliance, and describing smart-contract-based custody, oversight, and milestone controls.
